name: ley-memory
description: Private, local project memory and cited continuity across Codex sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Local project memory across Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Ley Memory connects Codex to a user-owned local vault through MCP, lifecycle hooks, and the Ley skill. It resumes bounded cited context, captures structured decisions and problem-solving, saves a redacted fallback, and keeps learning approval under user control.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use @Ley to resume this project's durable local context, continue its current Ley session, and checkpoint meaningful work before responding.
